sourceVersion: D41159B, copyright 2024, metric Technical Specifications, pages 1–4

radiusAdjustment.note: Manufacturer documents radius adjustment and minimum radii, but a quantitative flow law at manually reduced radius was not found. Matched precipitation claims alone were not used to infer a flow formula.

compatibilityNote: 1800 specification explicitly accepts R-VAN; R-VAN specification recommends 1800 or RD1800 with 45 psi regulation. Interface compatibility does not imply that a PRS30 body meets the 3.1 bar recommended operating pressure.
notes: Source page 2 states model-specific minimum reduced radii.
Source page 4 recommends 1800SAM-P45 in sandy environments.
Radius represents recommended head-to-head spacing; square/triangle precipitation uses spacing at 50% of throw diameter.
No R-VAN performance rows are duplicated here: the owner already has the nine-model, 198-row current performance dataset.
